cause: A transient Windows access denial during atomic publication. A held ordinary reader reproduces this error; the particular blocking handle was not captured.
resolution: Removed all owned concurrent manifest polling. Monitor only the append-only log; finalization waits for the producer subprocess to exit. Numerical source/configuration are unchanged; resume validates and retains every existing shard.
monitoring_reader_experiment: Ordinary held reader blocked os.replace as expected. A FILE_SHARE_DELETE wrapper also failed to permit replacement in this environment, so that mitigation was rejected and is not used.
